basis: Developmental pulmonary capillary/venous disease with severe pulmonary hypertension; intestinal malrotation in 30-79%; renal anomalies below 30%.
Deficient delta/beta globin synthesis causes microcytic anemia; no common direct extrahematologic damage established.
Streptococcal toxin-mediated shock; renal failure roughly 70% and ARDS roughly 50%; coagulopathy and hepatic injury omitted at the four-axis cap.
Benign peripheral nerve sheath tumor arising within the esophagus.
Hodgkin lymphoma is a lymphoid-cell malignancy; no common extranodal organ damage established for this subtype.
Neuroendocrine neoplasm originating in the stomach; differentiation alone does not establish endocrine dysfunction. Anemia is a separate diagnosis.
Primary lymphatic vascular malformation; chronic skin hyperkeratosis, erosion and scarring in 30-79%. Cellulitis is separate; dystonia ancestry contradicts the definition.
Zellweger-spectrum peroxisomal disorder with defining neurologic dysfunction; hepatopathy and hearing loss commonly exceed 30%; retinal disease omitted at cap.
Intracranial abscess is a localized infection occupying the central nervous system compartment.
Structural corneal thinning and ectasia with protrusion of underlying tissue; confined to the eye.
Usher syndrome defines combined sensorineural deafness, vestibular dysfunction and retinal disease; left ventricular hypertrophy reported in 2/5 patients (40%).
Plasminogen deficiency causes damaging fibrin-rich mucosal membranes; ocular disease 80-99%, gingival disease 30-79%. Hydrocephalus is generally a minority despite the 2/2 series.
Primary tumor of the prostate, a reproductive organ outside the axes; metastatic or obstructive complications are not universal defining involvement.
Inherited multiple benign hair-follicle tumors affecting the skin.
Immune-mediated neutrophilic skin disease causing destructive ulcers and scars; arthralgia and myalgia do not establish musculoskeletal damage.
Adrenal hypercortisolism; bone loss/myopathy roughly 40-80%, skin atrophy/striae >50%, hypertension roughly 70% in overt Cushing syndrome; subtype frequencies uncertain.
Brain/radial defects define syndrome; nasal aplasia and auditory canal atresia each 80-99%. Cardiac, renal, ocular, biliary and oral anomalies omitted at cap.
Isolated spermatogenic failure causes azoospermia and infertility; reproductive function has no axis, and endocrine dysfunction is not established.
Joubert syndrome with cerebellar/cortical malformations; limb polydactyly and hypermetropia each reported in 1/1 patient, so frequency estimates are uncertain.
Defining hair/skin abnormalities, malformed teeth with enamel hypoplasia, and syndactyly affect skin, oral structures and limb anatomy.
Meckel syndrome with cystic renal dysplasia, encephalocele and limb defects; hepatic ductal plate malformation/fibrosis occurs in most Meckel cases; subtype evidence limited.
Epstein-Barr virus infection causing liver inflammation; the skin ancestry does not establish damaging cutaneous disease.
Defined by atrial septal defect combined with acquired mitral stenosis; an immune etiology is not required.
Glycosylation disorder impairs neuromuscular transmission and causes tubular-aggregate muscle pathology; retinoschisis reported in 2/4 patients (50%).
Synonyms and ancestry establish congenital fatal hepatic steatosis; no specific metabolic defect or common extrahepatic damage is established.
